citation.authors: Mok A, Haldar S, Lee JCY, Leow MKS, Henry CJ
citation.title: Postprandial changes in cardiometabolic disease risk in young Chinese men following isocaloric high or low protein diets, stratified by either high or low meal frequency - a randomized controlled crossover trial

population.description: Ten healthy Chinese men in Singapore (Table 1: age 28.8 (SD 6.6) y, range 22-40; BMI 21.9 (1.7) kg/m2, range 19.5-24.5; body mass 68.2 (7.8) kg); recruited aged 21-40, non-smokers, BMI <= 25, fasting glucose <= 5.5 mmol/l, no endocrine or metabolic disorder; each did all four diets in random order, >= 3 days apart

protocols.name: con2
protocols.description: CON-2: two large low-protein meals, breakfast at 08:00 (Table 2: 130 g carbohydrate, 32 g fat, 23 g protein; white bread, margarine, malted cocoa drink) and lunch at 12:30 (134 g carbohydrate, 53 g fat, 26 g protein; chicken soup noodles, cashew nuts). Test day 08:00-16:30 after a 12 h fast from a standardized evening meal, seated passive work in a 22-24 degC suite; fasting venous sample at 0 h (08:00) then samples at 1, 2.5, 4, 5.5, 7 and 8.5 h after the first meal (Table 3); each meal eaten within 15 min, modelled at its serving minute

meals.food: white bread 171 g, margarine 30 g, malted cocoa drink 375 g
chicken soup noodles 225 g, cashew nuts 30 g

protocols.name: con6
protocols.description: CON-6: the CON-2 breakfast and lunch each divided into 3 equal isocaloric portions, served at 08:00, 09:30, 11:00, 12:30, 14:00, 15:30. Test day 08:00-16:30 after a 12 h fast from a standardized evening meal, seated passive work in a 22-24 degC suite; fasting venous sample at 0 h (08:00) then samples at 1, 2.5, 4, 5.5, 7 and 8.5 h after the first meal (Table 3); derived: the first three portions are taken to be the breakfast thirds and the last three the lunch thirds (the paper says breakfast and lunch were each divided into 3 equal portions and that 08:00 and 12:30 coincide with the 2-meal times), each = Table 2 grams / 3: breakfast 130/3 = 43.333 g carbohydrate, 32/3 = 10.667 g fat, 23/3 = 7.667 g protein; lunch 134/3 = 44.667 g carbohydrate, 53/3 = 17.667 g fat, 26/3 = 8.667 g protein; meal details: each portion taken to hold a third of each of its meal's foods (Table 2 constituents), as the paper says only that breakfast and lunch were 'each divided into 3 equal, isocaloric portions'

protocols.name: pro2
protocols.description: PRO-2: two large high-protein meals, breakfast at 08:00 (Table 2: 66 g carbohydrate, 31 g fat, 89 g protein; milk, ice cream, whey powder, cashew nuts) and lunch at 12:30 (75 g carbohydrate, 37 g fat, 90 g protein; braised chicken, prawn dumplings, malted cocoa drink). Test day 08:00-16:30 after a 12 h fast from a standardized evening meal, seated passive work in a 22-24 degC suite; fasting venous sample at 0 h (08:00) then samples at 1, 2.5, 4, 5.5, 7 and 8.5 h after the first meal (Table 3); each meal eaten within 15 min, modelled at its serving minute

meals.food: milk 300 g, ice cream 150 g, whey powder 91.2 g, cashew nuts 30 g
braised chicken 330 g, prawn dumplings 120 g, malted cocoa drink 375 g

protocols.name: pro6
